purpose: Teach: スニーカー/きゅうり/太く/ねじ/子守/鈍感/包む/乗り場

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、スニーカー、絶対、で、絶対、ジョギング、絶対、始めたわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm really serious—I've started jogging in sneakers every single day.
lines.style: Warm, almost conspiratorial excitement. Soft attack on the opening. Rushes slightly through the middle from sheer enthusiasm, then settles at the end with tender certainty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、おばあちゃんの畑の、絶対、きゅうり、絶対、もらってきたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm totally serious—I brought home cucumbers from Grandma's garden, I really did.
lines.style: Bright, earnest child-voice. Rapid breath at the opening, like he can't wait to share. Sits forward on each stressed word. Eyes wide with the importance of it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お庭の木、絶対、太く、絶対、なってきたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I'm really serious—the tree in our yard has gotten so much thicker, hasn't it?
lines.style: Gentle, noticing tone. Pause before 'thicker' like she's marveling at the change. Warm exhale mid-sentence. Trails thoughtfully at the end, inviting him in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お家の、絶対、ねじ、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お手伝いで、絶対、締めたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm totally serious—I even tightened all the screws around the house to help out.
lines.style: Small boy's voice, bright with pride. Careful enunciation on 'tightened'—he did this right and wants her to know. Chest open, not shy. Ends with quiet satisfaction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、近所の、絶対、子守、絶対、引き受けてきたのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I'm really serious—I've taken on babysitting for the neighborhood kids now too.
lines.style: Animated, almost playful energy. Picks up pace slightly. Warm breath underneath. Life-expanding tone—she's doing more, becoming more. Genuine delight in her own doing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、鈍感、絶対、なんだって、絶対、お母さんが、言ってたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm totally serious—Mom said I've been a little bit dense about things lately.
lines.style: Wry, self-aware child-voice. Slight smirk underneath. Doesn't rush through the self-criticism. Looks up at her, inviting gentle disagreement or understanding.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、翔くんへの、絶対、お土産、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、包む、絶対、わね
lines.en: Sho, I'm really serious—I wrap your souvenirs so carefully, don't I?
lines.style: Tender, almost intimate tone. Slow, deliberate pace on 'wrap.' Each word given weight. Soft eye contact. This is about care expressed through small actions.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、駅の、絶対、乗り場、絶対、ぼく、絶対、メイ姉さんを、絶対、待ってたんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm totally serious—I was waiting for you at the station platform the whole time.
lines.style: Child-voice, quieter than before. Gentle realization underneath. Not accusatory—just stating what he did, what he felt. Trailing-off like he's still a little in that waiting.
